mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence indices
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of instances when HOUST > 1200, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2.5% eases monetary conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of other market conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 2.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200,000 in a month, the combined labor market strength predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and SPX performance
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 5% YoY signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 52% of instances when INDPRO YoY growth > 5%, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) growth exceeding 4% QoQ indicates strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical RSAFS and retail sales correlations
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of instances when RSAFS QoQ growth > 4%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly declines in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% signal easing inflation pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns after consecutive CPI declines are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 6% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) shows a YoY growth rate above 3%, the labor market's dual strength predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to impending monetary tightening.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and monetary policy responses
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: GDP (GDPC1) growth above 4% QoQ, combined with housing starts (HOUST) above 1000 units, signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical GDP and housing market correlations
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 52% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window.
